findings.impact: The two weaker tests would pass even if the function failed with an unrelated non-zero exit (e.g., unbound variable, missing shasum binary). A future regression that silently exits non-zero for a different reason would not be caught as the specific empty-input guard regression it is.
findings.mitigation: Add stderr content assertion to both tests: assert 'empty path' in res.stderr.lower() or 'refused' in res.stderr.lower(), mirroring the pattern at test_empty_sha_bypass.py:45.

findings.claim: mkdir -p + chmod 0700 two-step pattern still present at three sites in scp-policy-check (lines 229-230, 273-274, 367-368). Atomic mkdir -p -m 0700 was specified in R1-SBP-MIN-04 mitigation; not applied in fr1, fr2, or fr3.
findings.evidence: scp-policy-check:229-230: 'mkdir -p "$cache_dir"' then 'chmod 0700 "$cache_dir"'. Lines 273-274: same pattern for conftest cache_dir. Lines 367-368: 'mkdir -p "${CACHE_ROOT}"' then 'chmod 0700 "${CACHE_ROOT}"'. Unchanged from R3.
findings.impact: Sub-millisecond TOCTOU window between mkdir and chmod on shared-machine or shared-container environments where another process with the same UID can enter or observe the directory between the two syscalls.
findings.mitigation: Replace all three occurrences with 'mkdir -p -m 0700 "$dir"'. One-line change per site.

findings.claim: install -m 0755 places binaries world-executable inside 0700 cache directories. R1-SBP-MIN-04 specified install -m 0700; not applied.
findings.impact: Audit inconsistency; directory ACL is effective protection. If cache_dir permissions are relaxed or bypassed by a future change, binaries remain world-executable, enabling substitution by any local user.
findings.mitigation: Change install -m 0755 to install -m 0700 at lines 245 and 308.

findings.claim: Conftest archive_sha256 verification is silently optional via '|| true'. If omitted from a future lockfile bump, archive is extracted without integrity check.
findings.evidence: scp-policy-check:264: 'expected_archive_sha="$(json_lock_field conftest "$platform_key" archive_sha256 2>/dev/null || true)"'. Line 287: 'if [ -n "$expected_archive_sha" ] && ! verify_file_sha ...' — guard is skipped when field is absent. Unchanged from R3.
findings.impact: A 020F Renovate bump PR that omits archive_sha256 silently degrades to binary-only verification, losing MITM protection at the archive extraction stage with no operator-visible error.
findings.mitigation: Remove '2>/dev/null || true'. If archive_sha256 is absent from the lockfile, emit SCP-E001 and exit 1 unless an explicit sentinel (e.g., archive_sha256: none) is present, making the opt-out observable.

findings.claim: SCP_FIXTURE_PATH is passed directly to git diff in the local script without control-character or traversal validation. CI has a Python + bash guard; the local script does not.
findings.evidence: scp-policy-check:328: 'git diff --name-only "${SCP_BASE_SHA}..${SCP_HEAD_SHA}" -- "${SCP_FIXTURE_PATH:-.}"' with no preceding validation of SCP_FIXTURE_PATH. CI policy-check.yml:249-258 has a Python guard rejecting empty, \n, \r, \x00; policy-check.yml:260 has a bash guard asserting path exists. Unchanged from R3.
findings.impact: SCP_FIXTURE_PATH=../../etc or a value containing \n silently corrupts the changed-files manifest fed to conftest, potentially causing conftest to evaluate files outside the intended scope.
findings.mitigation: Mirror policy-check.yml:249-258 in prepare_changed_files: reject values containing \n \r \x00; if non-default, assert path exists under REPO_ROOT via realpath comparison.

findings.claim: Local script performs no Sigstore gh attestation verify on OPA binary; CI does. Local-repro and CI paths diverge on supply-chain assurance level.
findings.evidence: scp-policy-check download_opa(): no gh attestation verify call after install. CI policy-check.yml line ~207 runs 'gh attestation verify "${BIN_DIR}/opa" --repo open-policy-agent/opa'. Unchanged from R3.
findings.impact: A developer validating findings exclusively via local script operates at lower assurance than CI. A lockfile-committed compromised SHA passes local verification but would be caught by CI Sigstore.
findings.mitigation: In download_opa(), after install at line 245, add: 'if command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1; then gh attestation verify "$binary_path" --repo open-policy-agent/opa || { emit_error "OPA attestation verification failed"; exit 1; }; else emit_warning "gh CLI not found; skipping Sigstore attestation check for OPA"; fi'. Document skip path in ADOPT-001 §12.

findings.claim: Cleanup trap prefix match is fragile on macOS where TMPDIR resolves to /var/folders/... rather than /tmp.
findings.evidence: scp-policy-check:101-103: '[ "${CHANGED_FILES_PATH#${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/scp-policy-check.}" != "${CHANGED_FILES_PATH}" ]'. If TMPDIR is unset at cleanup time the guard evaluates against /tmp, which does not match the /var/folders path produced by mktemp on macOS. Unchanged from R3.
findings.impact: Temp file leak on macOS with non-default TMPDIR. File contains repo-relative paths only, no credentials.
findings.mitigation: Replace prefix-match with a boolean flag: set _SCP_CREATED_CHANGED_FILES=0; set to 1 immediately after mktemp; check the flag in the cleanup trap instead of the path-prefix guard.

findings.claim: conftest_json temp file in lib/policy_check_invocation.sh has no RETURN trap; python3 heredoc failure leaks the file.
findings.evidence: lib/policy_check_invocation.sh:167: conftest_json=$(mktemp ...). rm -f at line 179 covers conftest failure; rm -f at line 237 covers success. No trap covers python3 heredoc non-zero exit at lines 184-235. Under set -euo pipefail the function exits immediately on non-zero, bypassing line 237. Unchanged from R3.
findings.impact: One leaked temp file per malformed conftest JSON output. No credential content; cosmetic on ephemeral runners but accumulates on long-lived developer machines.

findings.claim: scripts/.tool-versions version pins have no automated bump coverage until 020F Renovate regex-manager ships.
findings.evidence: .github/dependabot.yml: github-actions ecosystem only, weekly. Inline comment defers .tool-versions tracking to 020F. Unchanged from R3.
findings.impact: CVE in OPA 1.15.2 or Conftest 0.68.2 requires manual detection until 020F ships.
findings.mitigation: No code change at 020B.2. Confirm 020F Renovate regex-manager scope covers scripts/.tool-versions version fields AND scripts/scp-policy-check.lock sha256/archive_sha256 fields in a single atomic bump PR.

The prior 'return 0' bypass is removed. scp_policy_check_verify_runtime_binaries:65-74 pre-flights all four env vars via ${VAR:-} expansion, collects missing[], and returns 1 with the full missing-var list before reaching the inner calls, which now use bare '"$VAR"' (safe because pre-flight confirmed non-empty). Closure confirmed by direct code read at commit 1a2c3eb.

structured_review.summary: R4 completeness-governance review of slice 020B.2 after fr3 (commit 1a2c3eb). Both R3 escalated findings are closed: R3-COMP-CRIT-01 (empty-string SHA bypass returning 0) is closed by the guard at lib/policy_check_invocation.sh:48-51 which now emits SCP-E001 and returns 1; R3-COMP-MAJ-01 (no regression test) is closed by test_empty_sha_bypass.py with 8 assertions covering both the inner function and the wrapper across all combinations of unset/empty inputs. The pre-exec verification gate is correctly hardened at both layers. Five MIN findings and three nit findings from R3 remain open — all were out of scope for the narrowly-targeted fr3. One new nit (R4-COMP-nit-01) is raised for asymmetric stderr assertion depth in two of the new test cases. §4.3 fixpoint is reached: no CRIT or MAJ findings remain. Merge to main is unblocked from this lens.
structured_review.verdict_rationale: R3-COMP-CRIT-01 (scp_policy_check_verify_runtime_binary returning 0 on empty path/expected) and R3-COMP-MAJ-01 (no regression test) are both closed by commit 1a2c3eb. lib/policy_check_invocation.sh:48-51 now guards empty path or expected SHA with return 1 and SCP-E001 error. scp_policy_check_verify_runtime_binaries:65-74 pre-flights all four env vars before delegating to the inner function using bare '"$VAR"' expansions (safe because pre-flight confirms non-empty). test_empty_sha_bypass.py adds 8 regression assertions. Five MIN findings (R4-COMP-MIN-01 through MIN-05) and four nit findings (R4-COMP-nit-01 through nit-04) remain open — the MIN/nit set was out of scope for the narrowly-targeted fr3. One new nit (R4-COMP-nit-01) is raised for asymmetric stderr assertion depth in two of the new test cases. §4.3 fixpoint is reached: no CRIT or MAJ findings remain.
